cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(sim_tuner_panel LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(Qt5 5.15 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets Network)
add_executable(sim_tuner_panel panel.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sim_tuner_panel PRIVATE Qt5::Widgets Qt5::Network)
install(TARGETS sim_tuner_panel DESTINATION bin)
